meta.note: Batch two of the push to 1000: food and the shop counters that sell it, colours, animals, money and post, daily routine, work vocabulary, weather — plus the multiword verbs (fazer compras, marcar uma consulta) that glue A2 speech together.

cards.ex_t: Como uma maçã todos os dias.
cards.ex_trans: I eat an apple every day.

cards.note: also the colour: cor de laranja
cards.ex_t: O sumo de laranja natural é outra coisa.
cards.ex_trans: Fresh orange juice is something else.

cards.note: Madeira's own, small and sweet
cards.ex_t: As bananas da Madeira são pequenas e doces.
cards.ex_trans: Madeiran bananas are small and sweet.

cards.ex_t: Põe umas gotas de limão no peixe.
cards.ex_trans: Put a few drops of lemon on the fish.

cards.note: as passas — raisins
cards.ex_t: No fim do verão há uvas no mercado.
cards.ex_trans: At the end of summer there are grapes at the market.

cards.ex_t: Os morangos estão em promoção.
cards.ex_trans: Strawberries are on offer.

cards.ex_t: Refoga a cebola primeiro.
cards.ex_trans: Sauté the onion first.

cards.note: pão com alho — the espetada sidekick
cards.ex_t: Falta alho para a receita.
cards.ex_trans: We're missing garlic for the recipe.

cards.note: bolo de cenoura — a lanche classic
cards.ex_t: As cenouras estão baratas esta semana.
cards.ex_trans: Carrots are cheap this week.

cards.ex_t: Uma salada de alface e tomate, simples.
cards.ex_trans: A simple lettuce and tomato salad.

cards.ex_t: Não como cogumelos, desculpa.
cards.ex_trans: I don't eat mushrooms, sorry.

cards.note: frango assado — Sunday's answer everywhere
cards.ex_t: Meio frango assado com piri-piri, por favor.
cards.ex_trans: Half a roast chicken with piri-piri, please.

cards.note: a thousand recipes, allegedly
cards.ex_t: À sexta há bacalhau com natas na cantina.
cards.ex_trans: On Fridays the canteen does bacalhau com natas.

cards.note: Madeira classic: bife de atum
cards.ex_t: O bife de atum com milho frito é típico daqui.
cards.ex_trans: Tuna steak with fried cornmeal is typical here.

cards.note: peixe-espada preto — the Madeira fish, com banana
cards.ex_t: Espada com banana é o prato mais madeirense que há.
cards.ex_trans: Scabbardfish with banana is the most Madeiran dish there is.

cards.ex_t: Sou alérgico a marisco, infelizmente.
cards.ex_trans: I'm allergic to shellfish, unfortunately.

cards.note: where the morning starts
cards.ex_t: Passo na padaria antes do trabalho.
cards.ex_trans: I stop by the bakery before work.

cards.note: açougue is the Brazilian word
cards.ex_t: O talho da esquina tem boa carne.
cards.ex_trans: The corner butcher has good meat.

cards.ex_t: Na peixaria diz-se cedo: o bom peixe voa.
cards.ex_trans: At the fishmonger's, go early: the good fish flies.

cards.note: the small old-school one
cards.ex_t: A mercearia do bairro ainda fia.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbourhood grocery still sells on credit.

cards.note: in Madeira and the south you may hear 'fino'
cards.ex_t: Duas imperiais bem geladas!
cards.ex_trans: Two well-chilled draught beers!

cards.note: sorvete is Brazilian
cards.ex_t: Um gelado de dois sabores, por favor.
cards.ex_trans: A two-flavour ice cream, please.

cards.note: meia dose feeds one; uma dose feeds two honest people
cards.ex_t: Meia dose chega bem para mim.
cards.ex_trans: Half a portion is plenty for me.

cards.note: modest in Portugal — round up and everyone's happy
cards.ex_t: Deixámos uma pequena gorjeta.
cards.ex_trans: We left a small tip.

cards.note: vinho branco — the one that matters at lunch
cards.ex_t: A casa é branca com portadas verdes.
cards.ex_trans: The house is white with green shutters.

cards.note: negro in some fixed phrases
cards.ex_t: O gato preto do vizinho dorme no meu carro.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbour's black cat sleeps on my car.

cards.note: encarnado is the older pt-PT word — Benfica's colour
cards.ex_t: O semáforo está vermelho.
cards.ex_trans: The light is red.

cards.note: also unripe: a banana ainda está verde
cards.ex_t: A bandeira é verde e vermelha.
cards.ex_trans: The flag is green and red.

cards.note: plural azuis
cards.ex_t: O mar hoje está muito azul.
cards.ex_trans: The sea is very blue today.

cards.ex_t: O autocarro amarelo vai para o Monte.
cards.ex_trans: The yellow bus goes to Monte.

cards.note: marrom is Brazilian; castanha is also the chestnut
cards.ex_t: Tem os olhos castanhos.
cards.ex_trans: She has brown eyes.

cards.note: cinza is the Brazilian word
cards.ex_t: O céu está cinzento, vem chuva.
cards.ex_trans: The sky is grey, rain is coming.

cards.note: invariable
cards.ex_t: As buganvílias cor de rosa estão em flor.
cards.ex_trans: The pink bougainvillea is in bloom.

cards.note: de que cor é? — what colour is it?
cards.ex_t: De que cor é o teu carro novo?
cards.ex_trans: What colour is your new car?

cards.ex_t: O gato da vizinha entra cá em casa como se fosse dele.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbour's cat comes in as if the house were his.

cards.note: cachorro in Portugal is a puppy — or a hot dog
cards.ex_t: O cão quer passear, chova ou não chova.
cards.ex_trans: The dog wants his walk, rain or no rain.

cards.note: ave is the formal word
cards.ex_t: Os pássaros acordam-me às seis.
cards.ex_trans: The birds wake me at six.

cards.ex_t: Há vacas no caminho para o Paul da Serra.
cards.ex_trans: There are cows on the way to Paul da Serra.

cards.ex_t: Nunca andei a cavalo.
cards.ex_trans: I've never ridden a horse.

cards.note: Madeira's sunbathing local
cards.ex_t: As lagartixas apanham sol no muro.
cards.ex_trans: The lizards sunbathe on the wall.

cards.note: mel de abelha da serra — mountain honey
cards.ex_t: As abelhas da serra fazem o melhor mel.
cards.ex_trans: The mountain bees make the best honey.

cards.note: the deep-sea Madeira special
cards.ex_t: O peixe-espada vive a mil metros de profundidade.
cards.ex_trans: The scabbardfish lives a thousand metres down.

cards.note: tens trocado? — the parking-machine question
cards.ex_t: Não tenho trocado para a máquina.
cards.ex_trans: I don't have change for the machine.

cards.ex_t: Preciso de moedas para o carrinho do supermercado.
cards.ex_trans: I need coins for the supermarket trolley.

cards.note: both the €20 and the exam result
cards.ex_t: O multibanco só dá notas de vinte.
cards.ex_trans: The ATM only gives twenties.

cards.note: carta de condução — the licence
cards.ex_t: Já tirei a carta há dez anos.
cards.ex_trans: I got my licence ten years ago.

cards.ex_t: Falta a sua assinatura aqui em baixo.
cards.ex_trans: Your signature is missing down here.

cards.note: tomar banho covers showering too
cards.ex_t: Vou tomar banho antes do jantar.
cards.ex_trans: I'll take a shower before dinner.

cards.note: chuveiro is the fixture, duche the act — banho covers both
cards.ex_t: Um duche rápido e saio.
cards.ex_trans: A quick shower and I'm off.

cards.ex_t: Perdi o pente na mochila.
cards.ex_trans: I lost my comb in the backpack.

cards.ex_t: Esqueci-me da escova de dentes no hotel.
cards.ex_trans: I forgot my toothbrush at the hotel.

cards.note: sabão is laundry soap — different thing
cards.ex_t: Este sabonete cheira a alfazema.
cards.ex_trans: This soap smells of lavender.

cards.note: xícara is Brazilian — chávena is a pt-PT shibboleth
cards.ex_t: Uma chávena de chá e fico nova.
cards.ex_trans: A cup of tea and I'm a new person.

cards.ex_t: Pode trazer mais guardanapos?
cards.ex_trans: Could you bring more napkins?

cards.ex_t: A sopa está na panela, é só aquecer.
cards.ex_trans: The soup's in the pot, just heat it up.

cards.ex_t: Esta frigideira já não larga nada.
cards.ex_trans: This pan doesn't release anything any more.

cards.note: no forno — roasted, the menu word
cards.ex_t: O bacalhau está no forno.
cards.ex_trans: The cod is in the oven.

cards.note: invariable in the plural
cards.ex_t: Aquece a sopa no micro-ondas.
cards.ex_trans: Heat the soup in the microwave.

cards.note: chamada perdida — missed call
cards.ex_t: Tens uma chamada perdida da senhoria.
cards.ex_trans: You have a missed call from the landlady.

cards.ex_t: Manda-me mensagem quando chegares.
cards.ex_trans: Text me when you arrive.

cards.note: also the person who carries
cards.ex_t: Alguém tem um carregador de iPhone?
cards.ex_trans: Does anyone have an iPhone charger?

cards.note: estou sem bateria — the universal excuse
cards.ex_t: Estou quase sem bateria, ligo-te depois.
cards.ex_trans: I'm almost out of battery, I'll call you later.

cards.ex_t: A impressora encravou outra vez.
cards.ex_trans: The printer jammed again.

cards.ex_t: A reunião de equipa passou para as três.
cards.ex_trans: The team meeting moved to three.

cards.note: o ordenado is the everyday word too
cards.ex_t: O salário cai no dia vinte e três.
cards.ex_trans: The salary lands on the twenty-third.

cards.ex_t: Ao domingo gosto de descansar.
cards.ex_trans: On Sundays I like to rest.

cards.note: acordar is the verb; cedo the pain
cards.ex_t: Odeio acordar cedo no inverno.
cards.ex_trans: I hate waking up early in winter.

cards.note: ir às compras — to go shopping
cards.ex_t: Faço compras ao sábado de manhã.
cards.ex_trans: I do the shopping on Saturday mornings.

cards.ex_t: Pões a mesa enquanto acabo a sopa?
cards.ex_trans: Will you set the table while I finish the soup?

cards.note: tirar, not fazer
cards.ex_t: Os turistas param para tirar fotografias.
cards.ex_trans: Tourists stop to take photos.

cards.note: marcar is the booking verb for everything
cards.ex_t: Preciso de marcar uma consulta no dentista.
cards.ex_trans: I need to book a dental appointment.

cards.note: apanhar catches buses, sun and colds alike
cards.ex_t: Fomos apanhar sol para o calhau.
cards.ex_trans: We went to catch some sun on the pebble beach.

cards.ex_t: Vamos dar um passeio pela marginal?
cards.ex_trans: Shall we take a stroll along the seafront?

cards.note: quando fazes anos? — when's your birthday?
cards.ex_t: A minha filha faz anos em março.
cards.ex_trans: My daughter's birthday is in March.

cards.note: atrasada for a woman
cards.ex_t: Despacha-te, estamos atrasados!
cards.ex_trans: Hurry up, we're late!

cards.note: maré alta / maré baixa
cards.ex_t: Com a maré baixa aparecem as poças.
cards.ex_trans: At low tide the rock pools appear.

cards.note: the surf-forecast word
cards.ex_t: A ondulação está forte demais para o barco.
cards.ex_trans: The swell is too strong for the boat.

cards.note: relâmpago is the flash
cards.ex_t: O cão esconde-se quando há trovões.
cards.ex_trans: The dog hides when it thunders.

cards.ex_t: Caiu granizo na serra esta noite.
cards.ex_trans: It hailed in the mountains last night.

cards.ex_t: De manhã a erva está molhada do orvalho.
cards.ex_trans: In the morning the grass is wet with dew.

cards.note: úmido is the Brazilian spelling — pt-PT keeps the h
cards.ex_t: O norte da ilha é mais húmido.
cards.ex_trans: The north of the island is damper.

cards.ex_t: O sul é mais seco e mais quente.
cards.ex_trans: The south is drier and hotter.

cards.note: in Portugal also 'bicha' from older folks — don't be startled
cards.ex_t: Há fila até à porta na finanças.
cards.ex_trans: There's a queue to the door at the tax office.

cards.note: ao balcão — at the counter, where coffee is cheaper
cards.ex_t: Ao balcão o café é mais barato.
cards.ex_trans: At the counter the coffee is cheaper.

cards.note: also the verb 'to walk' — context decides
cards.ex_t: Moro no terceiro andar, sem elevador.
cards.ex_trans: I live on the third floor, no lift.

cards.note: as obras — the roadworks eternal
cards.ex_t: As obras na estrada acabam para o mês.
cards.ex_trans: The roadworks finish next month.

cards.ex_t: O barco para o Porto Santo sai às oito.
cards.ex_trans: The Porto Santo boat leaves at eight.

cards.ex_t: A bagagem de mão tem limite de dez quilos.
cards.ex_trans: Hand luggage has a ten-kilo limit.

cards.ex_t: A paisagem do miradouro corta a respiração.
cards.ex_trans: The view from the lookout takes your breath away.
